<!-- ===============================================================
     ATLAS PAGE ONLY
     This file contains its own styles to keep the layout independent

<style>
/* The Quarto page title is the only top-level heading on Atlas.
   Keep the title block centered without changing global site styles. */
#title-block-header {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: min(100%, 1180px);
  max-width: 1180px;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: clamp(38px, 5vw, 64px) clamp(18px, 4vw, 48px) 0;
  text-align: center;
}
#title-block-header .quarto-title,
#title-block-header .quarto-title h1.title {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  text-align: center;
}
#title-block-header .quarto-title h1.title {
  font: 400 clamp(2.15rem, 4.2vw, 3.55rem)/1.2 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif;
  color: #243e43;
  letter-spacing: -.035em;
  margin: 0 auto 15px;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
}
#title-block-header .description {
  max-width: 68ch;
  margin: 0 auto;
  color: #526b70;
  font: 400 clamp(.96rem, 1.3vw, 1.05rem)/1.75 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
  text-align: center;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
}
#title-block-header .quarto-title-meta { display: none; }

/* All visual changes are scoped to this Atlas page, not other pages. */
.phs-atlas-page.phs-standard {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: min(100%, 1180px);
  max-width: 1180px;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: clamp(12px, 2vw, 22px) clamp(18px, 4vw, 48px) 88px;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
  word-break: normal;
  text-transform: none;
  letter-spacing: normal;
}
.phs-atlas-page *,
.phs-atlas-page *::before,
.phs-atlas-page *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.phs-atlas-page h1,
.phs-atlas-page h2,
.phs-atlas-page h3,
.phs-atlas-page p,
.phs-atlas-page a {
  max-width: 100%;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
  word-break: normal;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-eyebrow {
  display: block;
  color: #66877c;
  font: 600 .72rem/1.6 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: .15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 0 0 14px;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-map-section {
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px) 0 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #dce5e1;
  padding-top: 20px;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-map-label {
  color: #69877e;
  font: 600 .72rem/1.5 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-embed {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-embed iframe {
  display: block;
  width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  height: 322px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-map-note {
  color: #7a8989;
  font: 400 .82rem/1.65 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
  margin: 12px 0 0;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-map-note a {
  color: #426c79;
  text-underline-offset: .15em;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-research {
  border-top: 1px solid #dce5e1;
  padding-top: clamp(26px, 3.7vw, 44px);
  margin-top: clamp(35px, 5vw, 65px);
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-research h2 {
  font: 400 clamp(1.45rem, 2.35vw, 2rem)/1.3 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif;
  letter-spacing: -.025em;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: #293f44;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-research-lead {
  max-width: 65ch;
  color: #667b7d;
  font: 400 .93rem/1.7 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
  margin: 0 0 24px;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-papers {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0 35px;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-paper {
  min-width: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #e3e9e6;
  padding: 21px 0 24px;
  margin: 0;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-paper h3 {
  font: 400 1.03rem/1.55 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif;
  color: #2c4a51;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: none;
  margin: 0 0 9px;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-paper p {
  color: #6d7d7f;
  font: 400 .85rem/1.7 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif;
  margin: 0;
}
.phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-paper a { color: #336d7c; }
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .phs-atlas-page.phs-standard { padding: 12px 18px 64px; }
  .phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-eyebrow,
  .phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-map-label { font-size: .67rem; letter-spacing: .1em; }
  .phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-papers { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .phs-atlas-page .phs-atlas-map-section { padding-top: 18px; }
}
</style>

<!-- Use Datawrapper's official iframe-resize script.
It handles changing chart heights across desktop and mobile breakpoints. -->
<script type="text/javascript">(function(){function e(){window.addEventListener(`message`,function(e){if(e.data[`datawrapper-height`]!==void 0){var t=document.querySelectorAll(`iframe`);for(var n in e.data[`datawrapper-height`])for(var r=0,i;i=t[r];r++)if(i.contentWindow===e.source){var a=e.data[`datawrapper-height`][n]+`px`;i.style.height=a}}})}e()})();</script>
